fields.description: Issue features an exposé alleging Cuban figure Jose Aleman’s influence in Greater Miami and claims that a federal immigration official was transferred after investigating him. Includes editorials criticizing the Miami Herald’s coverage of an alleged “baby-racket” adoption case and arguing against monopolization of adoptions by favored agencies; coverage of the beach-access legal battle and contempt citations; discussion of AMA press-bribery allegations tied to health insurance advertising; reports on Miami police vagrancy enforcement and court cases; notice of new Dade County contractor qualification requirements; and local civic issues including Miami Beach teacher housing and upcoming city elections/polls.
